import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":34567,\"status\":\"approved\"}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/purchase_order_contracts/%7Bpurchase_order_contract_id%7D/subcontractor_schedule_of_values_status", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
